model: AQ Series wall air quality sensor (BACnet MS/TP)
equipment_type: Room air quality sensor (temperature / RH / CO2)
applies_to: Senva AQ Series (AQW) wall-mount sensors measuring temperature, humidity and/or CO2, with optional set point, push button and relay, using BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The AQ Series is a Senva wall sensor with native BACnet MS/TP. For temperature, RH, dew point and CO2 it gives a smoothed value, a raw value and resettable min/max Analog Inputs, plus the occupant set point. Analog Values hold calibration, smoothing, CO2 auto-cal, set point range and internal relay settings; a commandable Binary Output drives the relay.
notes: Points from the object sections of protocol guide 154-0012-0E (object list on pages 2-3).
RH and dew point objects need the humidity sensor; CO2 objects need the CO2 sensor.
Temperature values over BACnet follow MSV 2 (default °F), independent of the display units.
Override values (AV 26-29) only change what the display shows; they reset at restart.
Multistate objects are MSV in the guide; listed here as MV.

integration.summary: Set baud and MAC with the auto-configuration wizard or Setup Menu (BACnet stays off until both are set), choose BACnet temperature units with MSV 2, then read the smoothed temperature, RH and CO2. The BMS can command the relay through BO 0 when the internal relay program is disabled.
integration.enable: The internal relay program writes BO 0 at the priority in AV 25 (default 14) unless MSV 4 is set to Disabled; BMS commands at a higher priority win.
setup: BACnet stays off until baud and MS/TP MAC (0-127) are configured, via the auto-configuration wizard or Setup Menu.
gotchas: When the MAC address is changed over BACnet, the device answers on the old address and moves to the new one afterwards.
Writing any value to a Minimum/Maximum AI resets it; they also reset at restart.
